NAME: NetworkManager-wifi
DESCRIPTION: is what makes wifi work at all. It is a SEPARATE subpackage that a Fedora minimal install does not include, so without this line a laptop has no wireless after reboot.

NAME: linux-firmware
DESCRIPTION: provides the wifi, bluetooth and GPU firmware blobs the kernel loads at boot.

NAME: alsa-sof-firmware
DESCRIPTION: is the audio firmware nearly every laptop made since 2019 needs. Without it there is no sound at all.

NAME: xorg-x11-server-Xorg
DESCRIPTION: is the X server, the display server itself.

NAME: xorg-x11-xinit
DESCRIPTION: provides startx, which begins the graphical session.

NAME: xorg-x11-xauth
DESCRIPTION: handles the X authority cookie that startx requires.

NAME: xorg-x11-drv-libinput
DESCRIPTION: is the input driver. Without it X starts with no keyboard or mouse.

NAME: mesa-dri-drivers
DESCRIPTION: provides the DRI graphics drivers X needs in order to render.

NAME: xsetroot
DESCRIPTION: sets the root window name, which is how dwm draws its status bar.

NAME: xset
DESCRIPTION: adjusts X server preferences such as the keyboard repeat rate.

NAME: xprop
DESCRIPTION: queries window properties and is used to find the focused window.

NAME: xwininfo
DESCRIPTION: reports window geometry, used by the screenshot scripts.

NAME: xrandr
DESCRIPTION: manages monitor layout, resolution and DPI.

NAME: xrdb
DESCRIPTION: loads the Xresources colour and font settings.

NAME: setxkbmap
DESCRIPTION: sets the keyboard layout.

NAME: xkeyboard-config
DESCRIPTION: supplies the keyboard layout definitions themselves.

NAME: xdotool
DESCRIPTION: scripts X input and is used by the unicode picker and by remaps.

NAME: xclip
DESCRIPTION: reads and writes the X clipboard from the command line.

NAME: xcompmgr
DESCRIPTION: is a lightweight compositor, giving transparency without tearing.

NAME: unclutter-xfixes
DESCRIPTION: hides the mouse cursor while you are typing.

NAME: arandr
DESCRIPTION: is a graphical front-end for arranging monitors.

NAME: feh
DESCRIPTION: sets the desktop wallpaper.

NAME: brightnessctl
DESCRIPTION: controls display backlight brightness.

NAME: polkit
DESCRIPTION: handles privilege escalation for graphical programs.

NAME: dbus-x11
DESCRIPTION: provides dbus-launch and the X session bus integration.

NAME: dbus-tools
DESCRIPTION: provides dbus-update-activation-environment, which the session needs.

NAME: xdg-utils
DESCRIPTION: provides xdg-open, which routes files to the right program.

NAME: alerque-libertinus-fonts
DESCRIPTION: is the main serif typeface used throughout.

NAME: fontawesome-fonts-all
DESCRIPTION: provides the icon glyphs used in the status bar.

NAME: dejavu-sans-mono-fonts
DESCRIPTION: is a widely compatible monospace font.

NAME: google-noto-sans-mono-fonts
DESCRIPTION: covers monospace glyphs that Dejavu lacks.

NAME: google-noto-color-emoji-fonts
DESCRIPTION: renders colour emoji in the terminal.

DESCRIPTION: is the BLACK-AND-WHITE emoji font, and it is not optional. dwm's drw.c excludes colour fonts when searching for a fallback glyph (FcPatternAddBool FC_COLOR FcFalse), so with only the colour font installed every status bar icon silently renders as nothing while the numbers still show.

NAME: neovim
DESCRIPTION: is the text editor that everything defaults to.

NAME: zsh-syntax-highlighting
DESCRIPTION: colours commands in the shell as you type them.

NAME: man-db
DESCRIPTION: provides the manual page reader.

NAME: groff
DESCRIPTION: typesets the LARBS guide. The mom macros are not in groff-base.

NAME: bc
DESCRIPTION: is the calculator bound to ctrl-a in the shell.

NAME: unzip
DESCRIPTION: extracts zip archives.

NAME: lynx
DESCRIPTION: is a terminal web browser, used to render pages as plain text.

NAME: fzf
DESCRIPTION: is the fuzzy finder used for file and history search.

NAME: bat
DESCRIPTION: is a syntax-highlighting file viewer used in previews.

NAME: atool
DESCRIPTION: lists and extracts archives of many formats.

NAME: mediainfo
DESCRIPTION: reports media file metadata in previews.

NAME: poppler-utils
DESCRIPTION: extracts text and thumbnails from PDFs.

NAME: highlight
DESCRIPTION: syntax-highlights files piped through less.

NAME: socat

NAME: entr
DESCRIPTION: reruns commands when files change.

NAME: procps-ng

DESCRIPTION: reads CPU temperature for the status bar.

NAME: bmon
DESCRIPTION: shows a live bandwidth graph.

NAME: htop
